brief:
Palestine News Network launched an accountability programme episode focused on Battir, a town situated west of Bethlehem in the West Bank. The broadcast, according to Palestine News Network, combines examination of two distinct issues affecting Palestinians in the locality through reporting from different angles.

The first segment of the episode explores Palestinian heritage and cultural dimensions in Battir. The programme also addresses challenges within the fuel sector, presenting economic pressures facing Palestinians in the region. By pairing these narratives, the accountability initiative examines both the preservation of Palestinian identity and the material hardships confronting communities in the occupied territory.
